annotations.title: Daily market brief: crypto prices, stocks, USDC yield, gas and prediction markets

description: A morning brief in one call for a scheduled agent or a dashboard: USD prices for up to 5 crypto tokens, quotes for up to 4 stock tickers or indexes, the Crypto Fear & Greed index, the best USDC yields, Ethereum and Arbitrum gas, the top Polymarket markets by 24-hour volume and the UTC time. Cheaper than the six tools bought one by one. Use for a daily market brief, a trading or treasury agent's context, or a morning report. Example: tokens=BTC,ETH,SOL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

stocks.description: Up to 4 stock tickers or indexes, comma separated (default AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,^GSPC)

tokens.description: Up to 5 crypto tickers, comma separated (default BTC,ETH,SOL)
